text: The sketchbook was windblown. Tessa said, “I want to draw the sea.” Tessa fetched the map from the garden wall. Tessa followed the bathhouse path. Milo said, “I am worried.” The tide was high. Tessa said, “I need to turn.” She checked the map. Tessa and Milo followed the upper path. She drew the sea in the sketchbook. Milo watched the green anemone. The green anemone opened slowly. The sketchbook was still.
